prompt: Name a letter of the Greek alphabet

answers.name: Alpha
answers.fact: From the Phoenician 'aleph', meaning ox.

answers.name: Beta
answers.fact: Alpha plus beta gave us the word 'alphabet'.

answers.name: Omega
answers.fact: The last letter: 'the alpha and the omega'.

answers.name: Pi
answers.fact: Stands for the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter.

answers.name: Delta
answers.fact: Its triangle shape named river deltas.

answers.name: Gamma
answers.fact: Gamma rays are the highest-energy light.

answers.name: Sigma
answers.fact: Has a special form, ς, used at the end of words.

answers.name: Omicron
answers.fact: 'Little O', and the name of a 2021 COVID variant.

answers.name: Theta
answers.fact: Mathematicians use it for angles.

answers.name: Epsilon
answers.fact: 'Bare E'; maths uses it for a tiny amount.

answers.name: Lambda
answers.fact: Its capital looks like an upside-down V.

answers.name: Mu
answers.fact: Stands for 'micro', a millionth, as in μm.

answers.name: Zeta
answers.fact: The Riemann zeta function is one of maths' great unsolved puzzles.

answers.name: Eta
answers.fact: Its capital looks just like an English H.

answers.name: Kappa
answers.fact: Became internet slang via a Twitch emote.

answers.name: Rho
answers.fact: Looks like a P but sounds like an R.

answers.name: Tau
answers.fact: Some mathematicians argue 2π, called tau, is the better circle constant.

answers.name: Phi
answers.fact: Stands for the golden ratio, about 1.618.

answers.name: Psi
answers.fact: The symbol of psychology.

answers.name: Chi
answers.fact: Looks like an X; the X in 'Xmas' comes from it.

answers.name: Iota
answers.fact: The smallest letter: hence 'not one iota'.

answers.name: Upsilon
answers.fact: 'Bare U'.

answers.name: Nu
answers.fact: Its lower case looks like a v.

answers.name: Xi
answers.fact: A two-letter Scrabble favourite.
